shared_elements: low-relief carving arranged in horizontal registers
large flat rectangular field of decoration
justification: The only real correspondence is the organisation of shallow relief into stacked horizontal registers of small repeated motifs across a broad rectangular field, which is a generic compositional habit rather than a shared motif. B depicts a specific, legible menagerie — birds in profile, snakes, quadruped heads above a mesh/net band and a large bird with outspread limbs — whereas A shows dense rows of tiny sign-like marks with no identifiable creatures or comparable relationships between figures.
